VPS 4th fix 2026-08-06 (commit 816820c): Telegram polling could never succeed. The bot has a webhook registered (Supabase function), and Telegram refuses getUpdates whenever a webhook exists — 409 Conflict on every call. pollTelegram runs every 3s so it produced 114 errors per 20 min, the largest single contributor to the 15.6 MB log, and it meant inbound Telegram commands have NEVER reached the VPS server. ensureTelegramPolling now checks getWebhookInfo and skips polling when a webhook is present; runtime check, so removing the webhook restores polling with no code change. Webhook deliberately NOT deleted — separate integration, user's call. Verified 0 new 409s in 75s where ~25 were expected. Local unaffected: no TELEGRAM_TOKEN in its keys.env, zero 409s there.

VPS fixes 5+6 (commit b01051a) — Gold was invisible on two counts, neither a missing signal. (1) CONCURRENT REFRESH RACE: refreshSignals is called from 6 places but only the candle-ingest path checked signalRefreshInFlight, and that flag guarded it against itself only. At boot the slow Yahoo pass and the candle-flip MT5 pass ran concurrently and the slower one won per-asset — Gold served yahoo conf 74 while the broker feed said 0, i.e. futures levels for an account that fills spot. Fixed with a chained queue (chained NOT coalesced — joining an in-flight pass would skip the recompute the flip fired for). Tell: /api/mt5/candles says activeSource=mt5 while /api/signals says dataSource=yahoo. (2) R:R GATE ERASED ITS OWN EVIDENCE: it overwrote the whole reasons array and nulled levels, so a near miss serialised identically to "no setup formed" and learning saw nothing. Gold actually has RANGE_TRADE_SHORT at R:R 1.39 (entry 4257.06 stop 4387.99 target 4075.06) — missing the 1.5 bar by 0.11, not absent. Risk policy unchanged, diagnostics preserved. toFixed(2) replaces toFixed(1) which rendered 1.45 as "R:R 1.5 below minimum 1.5". Verified: all 3 assets now flip yahoo->mt5 together.
